candidate_grammar.boundary: Every supplied positive finite OPT-016 feasible support, objective, path, scenario and registered successor boundary.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete eight-axis OPT-016 product before observation access.
candidate_grammar.unique_survivor: OPT-016 uniquely retains complete-infeasible-or-successor-unbounded-certificate, complete candidate custody, root forcing, post-registry observation and no extra rule.

excluded_inputs: no axiom, fitted objective, imported optimizer answer or target outcome selects the result
host 0 denotes structural absence or counts artifacts only and is not an SFT number object
no negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof scalar
no opaque solver, sampled feasible subset or unregistered tie breaker
no unrestricted continuum optimum without a separate exact successor or enclosure certificate
no failed route retires an obligation or changes protected authority
statement: Infeasibility requires elimination of every feasible candidate; unboundedness requires a successor construction exceeding every supplied finite bound.
title: Infeasibility and unboundedness boundaries
